API part only. That change would have broken the contract, so I avoided it.

fix:API.contract:
All additive, camelCase JSON. /api/catalog/{version}/{lang}:
- GET /champions (ChampionList.entries[]) and GET /champions/{id} (.profile) — ChampionCard: + loadingArt: string (uri, required, e.g. https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/img/champion/loading/FiddleSticks_0.jpg); + blurb: string (required).
- GET /champions/{id} — ChampionDetails: + neighbours: DetailNeighbours (required).
- GET /items (ItemList): + related: EntityLink[] (required; {id, name, canonicalPath, image: CatalogImage, edition?}; one per distinct upgrade target of the returned entries, in first-met order). ItemCard (entries[] and ItemDetails.profile): + upgrades: string[] (required; ids of listed items it builds into, deduplicated, upstream order, key into related); summary now falls back to the description when plaintext is empty (same field).
- GET /items/{id} — ItemDetails: upgrades items are now ItemUpgrade {id: string, name: string, canonicalPath: string, image: CatalogImage, edition: Edition (required), gold: int (required, total cost)} instead of EntityLink; + depth: int | null (optional, Data Dragon depth; show 'Tier {depth}' when > 1); + neighbours: DetailNeighbours (required).
- GET /summoners/{id} — SummonerDetails: + neighbours: DetailNeighbours (required).
- GET /runes/{id} — RuneTreeDetails: + neighbours: DetailNeighbours (required).
- New schema DetailNeighbours {previous: DetailNeighbour | null (required), next: DetailNeighbour | null (required)}. No wrap-around; the order is exactly the list endpoint's (champions entries, items entries (Classic kept), summoners entries, runes trees).
- New schema DetailNeighbour {id: string (MonkeyKing / 3031 / 8100 / SummonerFlash), name: string, canonicalPath: string (e.g. items/3031-infinity-edge, to put under the locale prefix), edition: 'modern' | 'classic' (required; always 'modern' for champions and rune paths; badge only when 'classic')}.
/api/admin:
- GET /api/admin/builds — AdminBuildRow: + shareToken: string (required; the share page is /b/{shareToken}).
- AdminUserRef (AdminBuildRow.owner, AdminApiClientRow.owner, AdminContactRow.user, AdminDonationRow.donor): + isBanned: boolean (required).
- GET /api/admin/users — AdminUserRow: + riotTagline: string | null (optional; display username + '#' + riotTagline when set).
- GET /api/admin/audit/users/{userId} — UserActivity.subject (AuditSubjectView): + riotTagline: string | null (optional).
- GET /api/admin/analytics/report — AnalyticsReport: + geoAvailable: boolean (required; false = no GeoLite2 database, so show the 'base geo absente' badge and the explanatory paragraph).
- GET /api/admin/monitoring — MonitoringReport.services[] (ServiceProbe): + objects: int64 | null, + bytes: int64 | null (optional; set only on the 'storage' probe when a storage report is already cached, for the chip '{objects} objets · {bytes}').
/v1: unchanged.

The real causes were two render races, not only failed loads. My preview served /en/summoners with raw keys about one sequential render in four (7/30). (1) The summoners.search_placeholder pipe sits on an input of . A pipe used on a component's host element resolves that component's providers, so it saw the list's 'catalogue' scope instead of the page's 'summoners' scope. It showed the key only when another pipe happened to load 'summoners' first. Fix: catalogue-list now puts its scope in viewProviders, and a list.spec test proves it. (2) The chrome (header and footer) renders outside the router outlet, before activateLocale runs. Transloco counts a language as loaded as soon as any of its scopes is merged. So when a scope arrived before the root catalogue, setActiveLang (which ran before the load) made the pipes re-read root keys that were not there yet, and they stayed raw. This showed up on prerendered /en/ pages (header and footer as raw keys) in 3 of 4 builds where I added random delays to catalogue loads. Fix: a new core/i18n/inject-locale-switch.ts loads the catalogue first and activates the locale after; activateLocale and the shared-build resolver both use it. An SSR test in ssr-catalogues.spec reproduces the exact 'base.title' output with the old order. (3) Hardening from the verified fix: a failed catalogue load now calls a new PageResponse.forbidStorage(), which sends 'private, no-store' and keeps it even if a later cache() call asks for something else. Tested in the loader spec, the PageResponse spec and an SSR test where the route sets 'latest'. Results after the fixes: /en/summoners 0/40 raw; SSR 196 pages across 7 locales 0 raw; builds with random catalogue delays: prerender 0/168 raw in 3 builds, SSR 0/168 raw in 3 passes, output identical across renders; hydrated DOM 0/524 states.
